description: The voices the project can speak in: the ones it kept (each with its name, its voiceId and its kind: library, designed or cloned), how many voices of its own (designed or cloned together) its plan allows and how many are made, Marsell's stock voices, and what a voice-over costs a minute. A kept voice is used by picking it by name in Create's voice choice, or by passing its name or voiceId wherever a voice is asked for (ask_marsell, a video's voice). Find more with voice_library_search; clone the owner's own with voice_clone.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.
